design_decision.baseline_fact: Two immutable GTK live routes disproved RequireSurroundingText as a deterministic pre- or post-mutation acknowledgement. Official IBus source proves that legacy effects can straddle the processing_key_event boundary.
design_decision.selected_route: Committed-tail ManualToggleV3 delegates without an IBus text mutation. The daemon captures one exact VisibleTailV2 snapshot, builds one shared literal projection plan, acquires the physical grab, revalidates source focus epoch and suffix, establishes target-layout readiness, revalidates the same lease after the controlled engine handoff, and emits one Backspace plus exact uinput replay.
design_decision.legacy_repair: The old delegated-uinput route is reused only for its physical isolation and layout readiness. Its WordBuffer-derived plan is forbidden for IME committed tails because it can omit an accepted autocomplete suffix.
design_decision.active_composition: Active composition remains IME-owned and daemon WordBuffer remains a separate configured-backend lane.
design_decision.rollback_boundary: Remove the failed V4 pending fresh-snapshot fence, retain all V1-V4 and live-failure evidence, and leave installed runtime bytes unchanged.

consequence_analysis.candidate_and_ranking: No candidate, ranking, correction model, dictionary, or keyboard mapping changes.
consequence_analysis.latency: The route is synchronous and bounded by one snapshot call, two exact lease checks, existing layout readiness, and one short replay. No timer, polling, or retry is added.
consequence_analysis.cpu_rss_allocation: One bounded plan, snapshot, lease, and key-event vector per explicit toggle; no worker, queue, cache, or persistent allocation.
consequence_analysis.cache_reload_learning: Package, cache, reload, and learning authority are unchanged. Daemon replay memory is reconstructed only from the exact post-replay visible-tail projection.
consequence_analysis.concurrency: Physical input remains grabbed from pre-mutation revalidation through replay. Any source, focus, epoch, suffix, layout-readiness, or second-lease mismatch aborts before Backspace.
consequence_analysis.failure_and_rollback: Before-delete failure restores the initial layout best effort and leaves text unchanged. Any emission failure is terminal evidence and grants no retry. Managed-test cleanup restores desktop authority.
consequence_analysis.compatibility: Active composition, daemon buffer, terminal passthrough, pending auto-undo, and the sole daemon pair detector keep distinct existing routes.
consequence_analysis.maintenance: A dedicated exact committed-tail replay function avoids broadening the generic WordBuffer correction pipeline.
